title: Honest Work: Knock the variance tower

whoWantsWhat.wants: Knock the leftover variance tower. Swing mass through it, or cut it down.
whoWantsWhat.because: Leftover beat 1 is the wrecking-ball contract. Not B0 mine-and-dock. Not chapter-sheet cargo recategorize.

whoWantsWhat.wants: Stay standing until leftover mass or leftover shot takes it.
whoWantsWhat.because: Leftover physicalRole demolition_tower. Scan label DEAD TOWER. Solid leftover wreck, not a mining rock.

whoWantsWhat.wants: The tower knocked. The variance file closed by a physical knock.
whoWantsWhat.because: Leftover B1 contact. Clerk voice. Payment is leftover 600 after the knock lands.

whoWantsWhat.wants: Remain the leftover dest. The tower is Helios-adjacent, not a Forge board place.
whoWantsWhat.because: Leftover campaign dest is station_helios / sector_helios_prime. Authored wrecking_ball catalog place is leftover Forge — this beat is the story leftover.

speakers.rule: Clerk voice: name the knock, name the two leftover ways, never explain the file.
speakers.example: Knock the dead tower. Swing mass or cut it.

speakers.rule: Meridian: leftover board issuer. Smooth, mercantile. The knock is a fee closed.
speakers.example: Meridian escort. Rates are fair, mostly. Fly safe.

speakers.rule: Frontier: plainspoken. Player hull, not a talking tree.
speakers.example: Frontier watch. Waystation’s open if you need it. Fly easy.

setPiece.place: Helios-adjacent variance tower in sector_helios_prime. Leftover dest station_helios. Dead tower, not a mining claim.
setPiece.twist: The leftover tower is solid wreck. Naming it on a throw release does not knock it. The swing has to contact. Guns are the leftover slow cut.

solutions.how: Run the sealed alloys from Helios to the Tethys berth and let the manifest re-categorize silent. Live completionMethod sealed_delivery (campaign47a:b1:alloy_run).
Deliver the run short — a partial settle still files. Live completionMethod partial_settle (campaign47a:b1:alloy_run).
Clear the repair mites off the infested hauler, then feed the ore pods to the CR-FEED intake. Live completionMethod mites_then_furnace (campaign47a:b1:infested).
Feed the hauler's pods to the furnace first, then finish the mites. Live completionMethod furnace_then_mites (campaign47a:b1:infested).
